subject: dsa
title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
summary: Hold two pointers n nodes apart. Advance fast to the end and slow lands just before the target, so one re-link removes it in a single pass.
problem: Remove the nth node counting from the end of the list and return the head.

steps.caption: Remove the 2nd node from the end. We don't know the length up front, so keep two pointers held exactly n nodes apart.
Put fast at the head, then move it n = 2 nodes ahead. Slow stays at the head, so fast leads by 2.
Move both one step at a time. Slow to 2, fast to 4.
Again: slow to 3, fast reaches the last node, 5. Stop: slow now sits just before the node to remove.
The node after slow is 4, the 2nd from the end. Re-point slow's arrow past it, from 3 straight to 5.
Node 4 is unlinked and gone. The list is now 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 5.
